children: OS Therapies filed a prospectus supplement covering the resale of up to 5,874,094 common shares and provided counsel's legal opinion on the shares' legality.
Prospectus supplement filed as part of Form S-3 registration covering resale of up to 5,874,094 common shares.
Selling stockholders may resell shares from time to time under the supplement, enabling potential liquidity.
Form S-3 (File No. 333-289443) was originally declared effective Aug 25, 2025; supplement filed Sept 10, 2026.
Company attached Olshan Frome Wolosky LLP's legal opinion on the legality of the shares as Exhibit 5.1.
